derivation: from a compound of G4314 (πρός) and the base of G1476 (ἑδραῖος);
def: to sit near, i.e. attend as a servant

occurrences.text: Do ye not know that they which minister about holy things live of the things of the temple? and they which wait at the altar are partakers with the altar?
